use_when: the task requires multidisciplinary judgment rather than only deterministic calculation
evidence, assumptions, trade-offs, strategy, policy, business, risk, or adversarial review must be synthesized
the user explicitly requests the GitHub expert team
API or compute results require independent interpretation and adjudication
do_not_use_when: a fixed API connector can directly return the requested public data
a deterministic compute operation can fully answer the question
the user requests an immediate factual lookup without expert synthesis
the ticket would contain secrets, private personal data, or unverified artifact identifiers without the underlying body

governance_chain.selection: deterministic Python sorts eligible exact endpoints by estimated task cost ascending and enforces distinct model companies
governance_chain.orchestration: NetworkX validates a bounded DAG: parallel independent analysis, one cross-review, one final synthesis
governance_chain.final_authority: deterministic constitutional validator and independent artifact revalidation

execution_contract.expert_count: 3 to 6, default 4, bounded by the admitted initial-call capacity
execution_contract.roles: N-2 independent analysts, one cross-reviewer, one final synthesizer
execution_contract.company_policy: selected and recovery models must use globally distinct model companies
execution_contract.provider_policy: each endpoint is explicitly locked and provider fallback is disabled
execution_contract.selection_policy: eligible endpoint capability floor, then estimated task cost ascending
execution_contract.quality_assignment: best official rank in the selected lowest-cost set performs final synthesis; second-best performs cross-review
execution_contract.recovery: bounded inside approved_budget.calls and selected after the initial lowest-cost distinct-company set

outputs: expert outputs or a structured fail-closed result
call ledger with actual models, providers, tokens, cost and errors
artifact manifest, independent artifact revalidation and authoritative final attestation
completion_rule: Only an authoritative PASS final status with independently revalidated primary evidence and final attestation is normal completion. queued, accepted, workflow success or artifact metadata alone are not completion.
restrictions: GPTs must not choose a concrete model ID or provider
experts cannot browse, call tools, plugins, APIs or download artifacts
Claude and GPT governance selection calls are disabled
no unlimited retries, replacements or agent loops
no heavy agent framework in the production path
no secret or private data in public issues
no self-answer by Web GPT before the GitHub report when delegation is explicit

upstream_guidance.api_first: Use the evidence and data center first when current structured public data is required.
upstream_guidance.compute_first: Use the computation and simulation center first when quantitative simulation or deterministic analysis is required.
upstream_guidance.evidence_transfer: GPTs must retrieve and verify complete upstream bodies and SHA values before creating the expert ticket.
